RENDER.description: View Render Settings (RENDER). Configure model-view rendering, organized into subsections like /VIEW/DISPLAY. Current scope: MODE (display-mode toggles) and DRAW (draw options). The request body is carried under 'Argument'. The response is { "message": <string> }. Requires an opened project and an active model view.

Argument.description: Render settings request body. Only assigned subsections are applied.

MODE.description: [MODE] Render display-mode toggles. Each flag acts as a toggle (same as the ribbon buttons): only fields set to true are toggled; false leaves the current state unchanged.

SHRINK.description: Toggle element shrink display when true.

DRAW.description: [DRAW] Draw options (Display Option dialog > Draw tab). Current scope: inactive objects only.

DISPLAY_ELEMENTS_NODES.description: Display elements/nodes of inactive objects. true: draw, false: do not draw.

LINK_ZOOM_AUTO_FIT.description: Link inactive objects with zoom auto-fit. true: include, false: exclude.
